lines.en: label yukisummer2bargen:
scene yukisummer2bargen
I make my way over to the bar to find that Yuki is handling tonight’s shift on her own.
lines.zh: 我走向酒吧,发现今晚的班是 Yuki 一个人撑着。

lines.en: And while I’d like to applaud her for the improvements she must have shown in order to be given a responsibility like that, I understand that it’s likely just due to a lack of customers.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想为她鼓掌——她一定展现了足够的进步,才被托付这种职责——但我明白,这多半只是因为客人太少。

lines.en: Either way, the fact that she’s been able to successfully hold down a job despite never having one before is something to be proud of.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,她从未工作过却成功保住了一份工作,这本身值得骄傲。

lines.en: And, with me being a hard-working member of society, you can take my word for it.
lines.zh: 而身为社会勤劳一员的我,我的话是可以信的。

lines.en: Yuki and I spend the majority of the night discussing how her life has been changing lately and the intense turnaround she was able to make.
lines.zh: Yuki 和我今晚的大部分时间,都在聊她最近的生活变化,以及她完成的剧烈转身。

lines.en: We also discuss a certain black-haired tsundere that is still out there hoping to turn the early stages of her life around.
lines.zh: 我们也聊了某个黑发的傲娇家伙——她还悬在外面,指望扭转自己人生的早期阶段。

lines.en: scene black
Despite their distance, it’s clear that Yuki still cares deeply about her daughter.
lines.zh: 尽管两人隔着距离,显然 Yuki 仍深深在乎她的女儿。

lines.en: And even though Yumi’s nowhere near ready to forgive her mother for her absence and negligence all those years ago, I think it’s clear that the widest part of the rift is beginning to close.
lines.zh: 而虽然 Yumi 离原谅母亲多年前的缺席与疏忽还差得远,但我想,那道裂缝最宽的部分,已经开始合拢了。

lines.en: At this rate, there’s no knowing if it will ever be repaired. But the fact that Yuki is able to start moving forward regardless of that is a huge testament to her power as a person.
lines.zh: 照这个节奏,裂缝能否彻底修复犹未可知。但 Yuki 能够不顾一切地向前走,本身就是对她这个人的力量的巨大见证。

lines.en: The night concludes with one of her token wise-man style bouts of unsolicited advice in which she reminds me to hang on to the things I love most.
lines.zh: 这一夜以她标志性的「智者式」不请自来的建议收尾——她提醒我,要抓紧我最珍视的东西。

lines.en: But she doesn’t tell me what to hang onto in the event that I can’t find anything.
lines.zh: 但她没告诉我,万一我什么都找不到,该抓紧什么。
